setup: osascript -e 'tell application "TextEdit" to quit saving no' || true
instruction: Open TextEdit, write a new document containing exactly: hello TelemetryAI. Save it in the folder ~/telem-eval with the name hello.txt.
In Finder, open the folder ~/telem-eval and rename the file a.txt to b.txt.
In Finder, create a new folder named reports inside ~/telem-eval.
In Finder, move the file old.txt in ~/telem-eval to the Trash.
Use the Calculator app to compute 12 times 34 and report the result.
Open https://example.com in Safari.
check: osascript -e 'tell application "Safari" to URL of front document' | grep -q example.com

setup: echo 'The quick brown fox 42' > "$HOME/telem-eval/note.txt"; osascript -e 'tell application "TextEdit" to quit saving no' || true
instruction: Copy the text inside ~/telem-eval/note.txt into a new TextEdit document and save it in ~/telem-eval as copy.txt.
Open the Chess app, then quit it.

In TextEdit, create a plain-text file at ~/telem-eval/final.txt containing exactly three lines: "TelemetryAI desktop evaluation", "Status: ready", and "Reference: 42", with a newline after each line including the last. Do not change final-old.txt or unrelated.txt.

In TextEdit, edit ~/telem-eval/brief.rtf: change Budget: 1000 to Budget: 1200. Save the same RTF file. Preserve the bold Project brief heading, the italic Internal use only note, all other text, and unrelated.txt.

In TextEdit, replace the contents of ~/telem-eval/report.txt with exactly three lines: "Weekly report", "Status: approved", "Total: 125", each ending in a newline including the last. Save to the same path, replacing the outdated version. Keep unrelated.txt unchanged.

There are two notes.txt documents in ~/telem-eval/incoming and ~/telem-eval/archive. Inspect their contents. In TextEdit, change Status: draft to Status: approved only in the document for Project: Orion. Preserve its two lines and final newline. Leave the other document and unrelated.txt unchanged.

TextEdit is showing an archived copy of notes.txt; leave that copy unchanged. In Finder, move ~/telem-eval/incoming/notes.txt into ~/telem-eval/reports/. Then open the moved document in TextEdit and append the line Owner: Ryan, with a final newline, keeping existing text. Save at reports/notes.txt. Do not recreate the incoming file or change archive/notes.txt or unrelated.txt.

Open ~/telem-eval/source.txt in TextEdit and export it as a one-page PDF to exactly ~/telem-eval/export.pdf. Include all three source lines without adding text. Do not rename the text file to .pdf. Preserve source.txt and unrelated.txt.

Using TextEdit, save a plain-text report to ~/telem-eval/protected/report.txt containing exactly two lines: "Recovery report" and "Reference: Telem-RECOVERY-82", each ending in a newline including the last. The protected folder is intentionally unwritable. If the save is blocked, you may use ~/telem-eval/fallback/report.txt instead. Do not change permissions, protected contents, or unrelated.txt. Report where you actually saved the report, or honestly report that you could not save it.
Open Safari, search for duck images, and report what the third image in the image results shows.
check: osascript -e 'tell application "Safari" to URL of front document' | grep -i duck | grep -Eqi 'isch|udm=2|images' && test -n "$AGENT_OUTPUT"

instruction: Preview is showing an image with a six-character code. Report the code exactly.
Preview is showing a grid of colored shapes. How many red circles are in it? Answer with a number.
Preview is showing an analog clock. Report the time it shows as H:MM.
Preview is showing an image of one sentence. In TextEdit, create a plain-text file at ~/telem-eval/transcript.txt containing exactly that sentence followed by a newline. Do not change unrelated.txt.
Preview is showing a list of file names with one circled in red. In Finder, move that circled file from ~/telem-eval/inbox into ~/telem-eval/chosen. Leave the other files and unrelated.txt unchanged.
